metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: KOBKOC crystallizes in the hexagonal crystal system with space group P 63/m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C102 H165 N30 Ni21 O177 Pr20 9+,9(N1 O3 1-),42(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Pr1 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr2 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr3 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr4 (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Ni1 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4 (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Pr1A (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr1K (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr1I (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr1J (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr1B (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr2I (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr2A (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr2J (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr2B (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr2K (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr3A (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr3I (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr3K (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr3J (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr3B (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Pr4K (Pr) has 9 O neighbors; Ni1A (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni1B (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2K (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2J (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2I (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2A (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni2B (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3A (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3I (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3K (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3J (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni3B (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4A (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4K (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4I (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4J (Ni) has 5 O neighbors; Ni4B (Ni) has 5 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 69 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.477-4.223 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 98.27-118.39°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Pr20Ni21(C4H5NO4)21(OH)24(C2H2O3)6(C2O4)3(H2O)12](NO3)9·42H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 24 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 12 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 9 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
